items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Gee. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, he could play real soft, you know. And my wife used to get nervous when he'd come around, even though she knew him. She'd known him back in the show days.

ctx.x: That was in 1968. And so he walked out. He said he wasn't going to make the date. So Duke sent Harry Carney after him. Duke didn't go after him. Duke sent Harry Carney after him. "Bring Russell on up to the date. Have him drive with us." And so Harry had the responsibility of talking Russell back into the band.
